title: Refuse Whenever You Feel Unsafe: Improving Safety in LLMs via Decoupled Refusal Training

bias_targets.methodology: Analyzing the token position distribution of refusal keywords (e.g., 'Sorry', 'I cannot') in safety tuning data and model responses, and evaluating the resulting vulnerability to jailbreak attacks using Attack Success Rate (ASR) across various attack methods (e.g., CodeAttack, CompletingAttack).
